brief: My balcony is full sun with moderate moisture, and a cat and a dog live in the household. A sunny balcony and one cat. I would like some cat grass for her to nibble on.

design.site_summary: A shady microclimate balcony with moderate moisture requirements for a curious pet cat.
design.layout_strategy: Trailing Asplenium fern cascading from the top vertical railing, upright Aspidistra and Ageratina anchored at mid-height against the inner wall, and a low grazing layer of Alyssum and Dill along the accessible balcony edge.
design.combination_logic: This combination merges fine frond textures with broad glossy leaves and soft herb cushions, offering a rich contrast in foliage shape and subtle seasonal blooms that remain completely safe and engaging for the pet across the year.

zones.placement: on the floor along the east-facing railing, 3 hours of morning sun, fully accessible to the pet

plants.why: Provides low, scented cushion growth safe for browsing.
plants.role_in_combination: Serves as a soft, low carpet at the base of the design, contrasting in texture with the taller foliage.

plants.why: Adds feathery edible interest within reach of the pet.
plants.role_in_combination: Brings an airy, vertical textural accent right above the low alyssum carpet.

maintenance: Water twice a week in summer, weekly in spring and autumn.
Feed with organic liquid fertilizer monthly during the growing season.

zones.placement: against the inner shaded wall, receiving filtered indirect light and sheltered from wind

plants.why: Extremely hardy foliage plant that thrives in full shade.
plants.role_in_combination: Anchors the mid-level with bold, dark green vertical leaves that contrast against finer textures.

plants.why: Perennial structure that thrives in shaded moisture.
plants.role_in_combination: Adds bright seasonal white flowers and a contrasting bushy habit.

maintenance: Water weekly in summer, every two weeks in winter.
Remove old dead leaves in early spring.

zones.placement: on the upper east-facing railing, receiving gentle morning light and partial shade

plants.why: Soft fronds ideal for hanging display above the pet's direct reach.
plants.role_in_combination: Cascades gracefully downwards, framing the entire composition from above.

maintenance: Mist fronds three times a week in summer, weekly in winter.
Keep soil evenly moist with frequent light watering.

zones.placement: in the bright corner of the balcony, 5 hours of full sun exposure

plants.why: Withstands full sun and dry conditions while remaining pet safe.
plants.role_in_combination: Serves as a striking sculptural focal point with cascading ribbon-like leaves.

maintenance: Water every ten days in summer, monthly in winter.
Ensure pot drainage is clear to prevent root rot.

care_instructions.task: Watering ground and mid-level containers thoroughly
care_instructions.frequency: Twice a week in summer, weekly in spring and autumn

care_instructions.task: Fertilizing foliage and herbs with organic plant food
Checking drainage holes in all pots to prevent stagnation

care_cautions: Overwatering and root rot in the hanging baskets containing Asplenium bulbiferum due to frequent misting.
Scorch on the hot west wall if containers are pushed too far into unshaded zones.
Drying out of Beaucarnea recurvata if neglected during intense summer heatwaves.
design.pet_safety_note: Every plant selected in this design is strictly non-toxic to cats and dogs, and the accessible grazing zone lets the pet interact safely with harmless herbs.
